explanation: Compared against Green Problem 92 ('Chase has improved this to e^{n^{1/5} log^C n}') and Chase arXiv:2009.03296, Theorem 1: for any q and δ there is C such that T = exp(C n^{1/5} log⁵ n) traces suffice. The statement specialises to q = 1/2, δ = 1/10 and asserts numTraces n ≤ ⌈exp(C n^{1/5} log⁵ n)⌉ eventually. Faithful.
